recipe.visualDefinition: A distressed, retro-style graphic featuring a dark blue silhouette of a cowgirl with a raised arm against a light blue background with concentric off-white circles. The composition is anchored by a bold, red-filled script logo with a white outline and a secondary banner containing block lettering.
coreVisualRelationships: Silhouette centered against concentric circular target
Text overlaying the lower third of the central figure
Heavy distressing and grit applied across all layers
Red script providing a vibrant focal point against cool blue tones
coreInvariants: Muted patriotic color palette (Red, White, Blue)

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central vertical silhouette, occupying approximately 70% of the height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The red script logo in the lower foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the raised arm, follows the silhouette down to the bold red text, then moves outward to the concentric circles.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Light blue textured field surrounding the central circular motif.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Steel blue background and dark navy silhouette.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Off-white concentric circles and text outlines.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep red for the primary script and banner.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation, mid-to-low value with a weathered, faded appearance.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Upright script with connected lowercase and a slab-serif secondary font.
letterConstructionRules: Script features thick, uniform strokes with rounded terminals
Heavy white outline creating a sticker-like effect
Secondary text is a condensed slab-serif housed in a curved banner
Integrated star motifs within the typographic lockup
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended descenders that merge into a banner shape
Custom ligatures connecting the base of letters

treatment.outline: thick white with thin dark outer stroke

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A fluid, heavy script paired with a rigid, condensed collegiate slab-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, rounded, connected feel of the primary text.
Matches the secondary text in the banner.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a distressed vintage poster background in dusty blue. Center a dark navy silhouette of a cowgirl wearing a hat with one arm raised. Behind her, place large, faded off-white concentric circles. Apply a heavy layer of scratches and paper texture across the entire image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, bold red script logo in the lower third, tilted slightly upward. Give the script a thick white outline and a thin dark blue outer stroke. Below the script, add a red curved banner containing white condensed slab-serif text and small stars.

verificationChecks: Is the texture consistently applied across text and image?
Does the red script have a thick white border?
Is the silhouette a solid dark navy?
Are the background circles centered and faded?

postGenerationChecks: Check for 'sticker' effect on the main text outline
Ensure the scratch texture doesn't obscure the legibility of the banner text
Verify the concentric circles are low-contrast against the blue background
recipe.reuseFormula: Distressed Americana Silhouette + Concentric Target Background + Heavy Outlined Script + Curved Banner Subtext
